model.notes: Qwen2.5-7B base (not Instruct); the Hugging Face repository Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B is the base model.

metrics.evaluation_scope: Complete benchmark test files (gsm8k 1319, math 5000, minerva_math 272, gaokao2024_mix 91, olympiadbench 675, amc23 40, aime24 30, aime25 30). Baseline is untrained Qwen2.5-7B base; final is the same model fine-tuned on the 3,000-row dataset selected by DataFlow-Evolver. Both measured under identical generation settings. The fixed 10% diagnostic subset used for in-loop feedback is reported separately under diagnostic_subset; those examples are included in the final full-test score, so the headline is not fully untouched.

reference_systems.note: Comparable systems evaluated under the same protocol. math3k_original is the 3,000-row Math subset of DataFlow-Instruct-10K, produced by the DataFlow team's human-authored DataFlow Math pipeline over the MATH and GSM8K training sets. math3k_gpt4o_rewrite reruns that official pipeline with GPT-4o, matching the pipeline LLM used by DataFlow-Evolver. Both references are trained and evaluated identically; qwen25_7b_instruct is the released instruct model shown as an external reference, not a controlled comparison.

diagnostic_subset.note: 10% per-benchmark sample at seed 42, materialised before evolution. This is the in-loop feedback signal the method used; the remaining test examples did not enter the optimisation loop. The final full-test score includes this diagnostic subset and is therefore not fully untouched.

settings.compute_budget: 8x NVIDIA A100-SXM4-80GB (driver 535.129.03); GPU 7 reserved for the embedding service. Effective runtime from logs, excluding waiting and scheduling gaps: pipeline plus data generation 3h31m57s across 5 iterations; checkpoint_000 baseline evaluation 22m25s with training_performed=false and no SFT; checkpoint_002 7-card DDP SFT plus diagnostic evaluation 17m11s; checkpoint_004 7-card DDP SFT plus diagnostic evaluation 18m32s; total effective runtime including all three checkpoints 4h30m05s. Calendar span was approximately 6h07m, including about 1h37m of gaps. SFT used full-parameter BF16 DeepSpeed ZeRO-2, world size 7 on cuda:0-6, batch size/GPU 1, gradient accumulation 4, 1 epoch, cutoff_len 16384. Evaluation used CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1,2,3,4 with DP=4, TP=1, PP=1, max_model_len 32768; greedy sampling once and competition-set sampling four times. Pipeline GPU occupancy was not archived, so its duration is not converted to GPU-hours. Tokens: 88.36M pipeline teacher (gpt-4o, 87,315 requests), 9.25M pipeline agent (Codex + gpt-5.6-sol effort xhigh, 73% cached input), 8.82M embedding (Qwen3-Embedding-8B, 15,000 requests), 0.22M ReviewAgent (gpt-5.6-sol, 7 requests); 106.65M total.
